name: Torn-paper hook stamp
purpose: Slam the hook number or claim on screen in the first second.
how: torn element, size 70-90, anim stamp, in = the hook keyword.

name: Silhouette subject
purpose: Show 'who' without faces or real likeness (the seller, the customer, the minister).
how: person element (color navy/teal/red), optional chair/building props; pop when first mentioned.

name: Filling-squares stat
purpose: Make a share or ratio feel physical (16 of 20, 80%).
how: seats element: n, cols, filled; squares pop one by one from 'in' to 'fill_end' anchors. Add a 'مثال' text if illustrative.

name: A/B comparison cards
purpose: Compare two numbers or options side by side.
how: two card elements at x≈200 and x≈520, accents red vs teal, each in on its own word.

name: Taped label
purpose: A short definition or rule (ROAS ≠ ربح).

name: Count-up number
purpose: Money or volume that rolls up as it is spoken.
how: number element with count_to (+ prefix/suffix, count_dur). Never put a minus sign before a number in RTL; write 'خسارة 5,000 ج'.

name: Warning siren + date
how: siren (anim shake) + calendar card with the date.

name: Highlighter headline
purpose: The key phrase of the section, with one word on a yellow marker.
how: headline element: pre / hl / post, size 76-104; laid out right-to-left automatically.

name: Money math reveal
purpose: Walk the viewer from revenue to what's left, step by step.
how: number (count_to) → steps of red pills (each in on its cost word) → headline 'فاضلك …' → wcard 'خسارة … ج'.

name: Icon flow with dashed arrow
purpose: Show a process (ad → cart → shipping → return).
how: icon circles (megaphone, cart, box, truck, return, receipt…) joined by dashed arrows; read right-to-left.

name: 'مثال' tag
purpose: Mark illustrative numbers so nothing reads as a real result.
how: pill color blue text 'مثال' (B) or red text 'مثال' (A) next to the number.

name: Comment CTA
purpose: Close with the workbook CTA keyword and lead magnet.
how: cta element: keyword in red + magnet pill; in on 'اكتب'.

name: Face card slide
purpose: Keep energy by moving the speaker card between top and bottom at each section.
how: automatic: scenes alternate card top/bottom; force with scene 'card': 'top' | 'bottom'.

name: Stamp CTA
purpose: Red rubber-stamp close for the keyword.
how: stamp element (auto-fit border), anim stamp, in = keyword.
